This is the TodoMVC home screen. Your to-do list starts out empty.
Click the input box, type your task, and press Enter. It shows up in the list right away.
Add a second task the same way. The counter below shows two tasks still to do.
Click the circle next to a task to mark it done. The task gets crossed out.
Choose Completed at the bottom of the list to see only the tasks you have finished.
